0022600021.text: The Houston Rockets visit the Dallas Mavericks in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, looking for a sixth straight win after starting 5-0, including 3-0 on the road, and sitting first in the Southwest and the West. Dallas is 3-2, seventh in the West and two games back in the Southwest, and both teams are missing players: Houston is without Marcus Smart (forearm strain), Reed Sheppard (back) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Alperen Sengun is day-to-day with back soreness and is a game-time decision, and Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The Rockets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 128-110 home win on October 21, and the teams split their 2025-26 meetings 2-2.
